_what: The production contract v1, QB-5 (production contract): the shape of components/<component>/adapter.json (or components/<component>/<folder>/adapter.json, a component's own adapter folder). One manifest per production component; contract.py check enforces every rule written here. Definitions, the team's (curator, told after). Spec: team/handoffs/2026-10-22-production-contract.md.

fields.kind: one components/naming/stages.json `types` id (email | video-ad | image-ad | carousel | landing-page) — the naming standard's list, never a second one
fields.report: argv: writes the component's observations through creative-queue's qcore.write_observation (runs/queue-shadow/ by default)
fields.detail: argv: `<id>` appended; prints the piece's parts [{n, kind, label, words, media: [{drive_id?, path_label}], position: {top, bottom} | null, ok}]
fields.apply: argv: `<id> <part|-> <word> [payload] --by <person>` appended; prints {ok, revision, message, paths?, ref?}; exit 0 done, 1 failed, 2 refused
fields.words: the change words this adapter takes: shared words, plus kind-specific words listed in kind_words
fields.kind_words: optional {word: what it does}: a word only this kind uses, listed here or refused
fields.try: optional argv, LD-83 (picture try first): same args as apply; makes preview results, commits nothing; prints {ok, message, tries}; exit 0 made, 1 failed, 2 refused. A verb, never a change word
fields.try_words: optional, with try: the change words try accepts — a non-empty list, each already in words, none refused

argv_rule: a list of strings; argv[0] is a repo-relative path to a file under components/ that exists (builder card rule 12: no lab code); a .py file runs with the caller's sys.executable
refused_why: A paid or outbound effect is never a change word: it stays an approval — a queue decision (cq.py approve) plus a person's press on the tool's machine, with an execution receipt.
kill_signal: more than 3 kind_words on one adapter: the spec's kill (the shared level is wrong) — check warns, never fails
